pre_authoring_check.description: Enforces immutable regex to prevent touching real corporate projects
Verifies target console driver (GCP, AWS, Azure, Salesforce, ServiceNow)
Verifies that required APIs (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Logging) and quotas are active
Enforces mandatory grounding against official Google Cloud Documentation, Codelabs & Quickstarts (cloud.google.com/docs)
Ensures demo sample code, PySpark/SQL scripts, and datasets are grounded in official github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform repositories
Enforces pre-baked warm data store replicas to eliminate synchronous indexing latency during takes

on_manifest_created.description: Ensures contract.json defines single-source parameters for both slides and console actions
Enforces Bloom's Taxonomy 5-Act Arc: Cold Open, Architecture, Live, Chaos Debugging, Checklist
Enforces Cognitive Density CD >= 0.40; bans filler words, tautologies, and corporate fluff
Scans commands and SDK calls against Google Cloud Deprecation Feeds & Release Notes
Cross-references architecture diagram topology and components against official Google Cloud Architecture Center reference blueprints
Cross-checks pedagogical structure and timing benchmarks against official Google Cloud Next technical sessions & Skills Boost lab guides
Asserts OpenAPI tool definitions include end-user OAuth2 JWT bearer token authorization pass-through
Ensures total duration is within requested tolerance (±10%)

on_slides_compiled.description: Verifies 0% node overlap with 30px safety padding on PromptCanvas slides
Enforces strict WCAG AAA contrast ratios (>= 7:1) across all slide text and backgrounds
Ensures only verified cloud vendor icons (GCP, AWS, Azure, K8s) are rendered

on_whiteboard_sequence_compiled.description: Verifies 0% node and label collision with 30px safety padding across the 5-tier Executive Agentic Whiteboard topology
Verifies that vector stroke unwinding durations align within 50ms of narration phoneme bounds
Validates that all data flow bezier curves have valid start and end anchor points matching valid node IDs
Ensures Google Sans and Roboto Mono strokes and component card backings on Studio White (#FFFFFF / #F8FAFC) maintain WCAG AAA contrast ratio (>= 7:1)
Verifies 1:1 dual artifact parity between compiled whiteboard sequence and editable Draw.io (.drawio) XML schema

on_trace_authored.description: Asserts strict equality between slide diagram tokens and live console step inputs
Verifies that selector resolution algorithms recursively traverse Shadow DOM roots (shadowRoot)
Audits console step sequence against official Google Cloud Quickstarts to ensure 1:1 operational accuracy
Verifies that all destructive API writeback steps (POST/PUT/DELETE) are preceded by a user confirmation step in the trace
Ensures trace assertion handles concurrent function calling telemetry without failing on call order
Enforces atomic dual-artifact output: verifies both telemetry.json and physical screencast frame buffer / raw_screencast.mp4 exist
Replays the trace 3 consecutive times against the ephemeral sandbox pool

on_flake.prompt: Step {FAILED_STEP} flaked on selector '{SELECTOR}'. Inspect DOM snapshot and re-resolve triad selector.

pre_replay_check.description: Probes internal console RPC; triggers background OAuth refresh if expired
Confirms outbound worker IP matches trusted enterprise IP whitelist
Validates that Google Sans Flex TTF font metrics match macOS baseline
Verifies Google LLC Developer ID (EQHXZ8M8AV) on macOS or Google apt repo package on Cloudtop to eliminate Santa endpoint security blocks
pre_replay_check.command: node --import tsx -e "import { inspectChromeMetadata } from './src/utils/chrome-path.js'; const m = inspectChromeMetadata(); if (!m.isGoogleSigned && m.platform === 'darwin') throw new Error('Unsigned Chrome binary detected');"

post_capture_check.description: Scans raw screencast video to ensure zero black or frozen frames occurred
Verifies that pauses >800ms feature lookahead camera focus drifts or metric pulses
Ensures every click and focus action has an unambiguous {x,y,w,h} bounding box

pre_composite_check.description: Omni 1.1 checks slide diagram icons against console video (e.g. Postgres vs MySQL icon)
Ensures all audio tracks are strictly 48,000Hz 16-bit PCM WAV before compositing
Enforces max 50ms boundary drift using zyvoriq studio1_timeline_sync math
Ensures all billing IDs, LDAPs, and internal domains are masked in the telemetry stream
Verifies that CSS telemetry coordinates (1920x1080) are multiplied by deviceScaleFactor (2.0) for 4K canvas (3840x2160)
Enforces minimum 12px dilation safety padding on all PII redaction bounding boxes to prevent sub-pixel font bleed
Verifies that pre-GA or Preview features contain the mandatory legal disclaimer slate

on_github_pr_opened.description: Re-records modified steps and comments on GitHub PR with a side-by-side Video Diff MP4

on_ui_drift_detected.description: Surgically re-records and in-paints 3-second UI deltas into master footage without a full re-render

on_socratic_certification_completed.description: Issues cryptographically signed Proof-of-Competence Certificate and logs to audit ledger

on_publish_ready.description: Verifies 1-Click Day-0 Reproducibility Kit: ensures Terraform main.tf, OpenAPI spec, Draw.io diagram, and eval test set exist

post_render_verify.description: Performs full multimodal cross-audit of final MP4 for audio-visual desyncs or semantic mismatches

post_publish_verify.description: Performs live HTTP GET on HLS manifest and verifies stream playability and unique cache hash
